tabs.label: Tabs
tabs.renameHint: Double-click or F2 to rename, drag to move

language.label: Language
language.description: By default, Younji follows the system language.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: By default, Younji follows the system theme.

security.title: Security
security.autoLockDescription: The vault locks after this delay without keyboard or mouse activity. Open sessions are then closed.
security.passwordChanged: Master password changed. The old one no longer works.

connect.title: Quick connect
connect.passphraseHint: Leave empty if the key is not protected.
connect.interactiveHint: No secret is entered here: the server asks its questions (password, verification code…) in a dedicated window.

unknown.title: Unknown host
unknown.intro: This is the first connection to {{host}}. Younji cannot yet guarantee that this server is the one you expect.
unknown.verify: Compare this fingerprint with the server's before accepting: on the server, run ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_<type>_key.pub, where <type> matches the algorithm shown (ed25519, ecdsa or rsa). Once accepted, the key is remembered.

changed.title: Host key changed: connection blocked
changed.warning: The key presented by {{host}} does not match the recorded one.
changed.explanation: Someone may be trying to intercept the connection (man-in-the-middle attack). It may also be a reinstalled server or regenerated keys. No credentials were sent.
changed.unblock: Check the new fingerprint with the server's administrator. Only then, delete the old key of {{host}} in Keys > Known host keys, and reconnect to accept the new one.

paste.title: Confirm paste
paste.lines_one: The text to paste fits on {{count}} line.
paste.lines_other: The text to paste has {{count}} lines: each line break will run a command.
paste.controlCharacters: Warning: it contains invisible control characters (shown below as symbols).
paste.preview: Preview of the text to paste
paste.truncated: Preview truncated: the full text will be pasted.
paste.broadcast_one: Broadcast active: this text will be pasted in {{count}} session.
paste.broadcast_other: Broadcast active: this text will be pasted in these {{count}} sessions, each with its own paste mode.

link.title: Open this link?
link.description: The text shown in the terminal may differ from the real address. Check it before opening it in your browser:

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: They use Ctrl+Shift so that the shell keeps its own shortcuts (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+R, Ctrl+W…).
shortcuts.pasteAlternative: Shift+Insert also pastes into the terminal. Links open with Ctrl+click.

errors.internal: Internal application error. See the log for details.

dialog.failed: The file picker could not be opened.

url.invalid: This link is not allowed: only http and https links can be opened.
url.open_failed: The browser could not be launched.

ssh.invalid_host: Invalid host address. Enter a host name or an IP address.
ssh.invalid_port: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
ssh.invalid_secret: The password or passphrase is empty or too long.
ssh.input_too_large: Text too large to be sent at once.
ssh.key_read_failed: Unable to read the key file. Check that it exists and is accessible.
ssh.key_too_large: This file is too large to be a private key.
ssh.key_passphrase_required: This key is protected: enter its passphrase.
ssh.key_invalid: This file is not a recognized private key (OpenSSH, PEM or PuTTY).
ssh.key_file_unknown: Unknown key file: select it again.
ssh.dns_failed: Host not found. Check the address or your DNS resolution.
ssh.connection_refused: Connection refused: no SSH server is listening on this port.
ssh.timeout: The server is not responding (timed out).
ssh.connect_failed: Unable to connect. Check the network and the address.
ssh.handshake_failed: SSH negotiation failed (no secure algorithm in common or connection interrupted).
ssh.host_key_changed: Connection blocked: the host key has changed.
ssh.host_key_revoked: Connection blocked: this host's key is revoked.
ssh.host_key_timeout: No decision on the host key: connection cancelled.
ssh.known_hosts_io: The known host keys file cannot be read or written.
ssh.no_pending_decision: No host key is awaiting a decision.
ssh.auth_failed: Authentication denied. Check the user name and the password or key.
ssh.channel_failed: The server refused to open a terminal.
ssh.too_many_sessions: Too many open sessions. Close some before opening a new one.
ssh.auth_prompt_invalid: The server sent an abnormal authentication request (too many questions): connection aborted.
ssh.auth_prompt_timeout: No answer to the server's questions in time.
ssh.no_pending_prompt: The server is no longer waiting for an answer.
ssh.invalid_answers: Invalid answers (too long or wrong number).
ssh.invalid_public_key: This public key cannot be deployed.
ssh.deploy_failed: Deployment failed on the server. It requires a Unix server (sh shell) and a writable home directory.
ssh.sftp_unavailable: The server does not accept SFTP on this connection (subsystem disabled?).
ssh.sftp_failed: The operation failed on the server.
ssh.sftp_not_found: File or folder not found on the server.
ssh.sftp_already_exists: An item with this name already exists.
ssh.sftp_not_file: This is not a regular file.
ssh.sftp_invalid_path: Invalid remote path: it must start with “/”.
ssh.sftp_invalid_mode: Invalid permissions: enter 3 or 4 digits from 0 to 7 (for example 644).
ssh.sftp_unsafe_name: File name refused: it could write outside the chosen folder or target a reserved file.
ssh.sftp_too_many_entries: Too many items or tree too deep: operation refused.
ssh.local_io: Cannot read or write on this computer (permissions, disk full?).
ssh.local_outside_root: Local path refused: it leaves the chosen folder.
ssh.edit_too_large: File too large to edit (16 MiB at most).
ssh.edit_conflict: The file was modified on the server since it was opened: save not uploaded.
ssh.local_root_forbidden: This folder cannot be chosen: pick a specific subfolder (not a drive root, nor your whole home folder, nor ~/.ssh or Younji’s data).
ssh.tunnel_port_in_use: This listening port is already in use on this PC. Pick another one or stop the program using it.
ssh.tunnel_bind_failed: Cannot listen on this port (system-reserved port or address unavailable).
ssh.tunnel_forward_refused: The server refuses to listen on this port (already taken, reserved, or forwarding disabled in its configuration).

connect.missing_fields: Enter the host and the user.

vault.not_found: No vault exists yet: create one.
vault.already_exists: A vault already exists: it will not be overwritten.
vault.locked: The vault is locked. Unlock it to continue.
vault.invalid_file: The vault file is unreadable or damaged.
vault.unsupported_version: This vault was created by a newer version of Younji.
vault.kdf_params_rejected: This vault's encryption parameters are refused (file tampered with?).
vault.io: The vault file could not be read or written. Check disk space and permissions.
vault.random_unavailable: The system random number generator is unavailable.
vault.password_too_short: The master password must be at least 12 characters long.
vault.password_too_weak: This master password is too easy to guess. Make it longer, for example with several unrelated words.
vault.invalid_name: Invalid name: 1 to 128 characters, no control characters.
vault.invalid_port: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
vault.invalid_username: Invalid user name (required when no identity is selected).
vault.invalid_tags: Invalid tags: at most 16, 32 characters each.
vault.invalid_snippet: Invalid snippet: empty or too long (16 KiB at most), control or invisible characters, more than 32 variables, or description too long (512 characters at most).
vault.invalid_secret: The password is empty or too long.
vault.identity_incomplete: An identity needs a password, a key, or both.
vault.key_in_use: This key is used by an identity: remove it from the identity first.
vault.identity_in_use: This identity is used by a host: change the host's identity first.
vault.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
vault.backup_only: The vault is missing, but its backup copy (vault.younji.bak) exists. To avoid overwriting it, Younji does not create a new vault: rename vault.younji.bak to vault.younji in the data folder, then restart.
vault.invalid_tunnel: Invalid tunnel: ports from 1 to 65535, destination required for -L and -R (letters, digits, . - _ : [ ] only).
vault.tunnel_exposure_unconfirmed: Listening on 0.0.0.0 requires explicitly confirming the network exposure.

book.no_identity: This host has no saved identity.

keys.export_failed: The file could not be saved.

sftp.not_found: The SFTP browser is closed (session ended?).
sftp.too_many_edits: Too many files open for editing (16 at most).

local.root_unknown: Unknown local folder: choose it again.

editor.open_failed: The text editor could not be started.

snippets.invalid_values: Each variable needs a value on a single line, without control characters.
snippets.no_target: Check at least one connected session.
snippets.send_failed: A target session is no longer connected: the text was not sent everywhere.

tunnels.no_host: Choose the SSH host that carries the tunnel.
tunnels.exposure_refused: Start cancelled: exposing the tunnel to the network was not confirmed.

create.title: Create your vault
create.intro: Younji encrypts your hosts, identities, keys and known host keys in a vault protected by a master password. You will be asked for it at every start.
create.noRecovery: This password cannot be recovered: if you forget it, the vault's content is lost. Write it down somewhere safe (password manager, paper kept in a safe place).

reason.idle: The vault was locked after a period of inactivity. Open sessions were closed.
reason.reload: The vault was locked when the interface reloaded.

strength.empty: At least {{min}} characters. A phrase of several words is easier to remember and stronger.
strength.score2: Fair: still too easy to guess.

hosts.deleteGroupMessage: The group “{{name}}” will be deleted. Its hosts are kept, without a group.
hosts.empty: Your address book is empty. Add a host to connect to it with a double-click.
hosts.deleteHostMessage: The host “{{name}}” will be removed from the address book. Its known host keys and identity are kept.

form.name: Name
form.noIdentityHint: Without an identity, the password or key is asked at every connection.

keys.title: Private keys
keys.empty: No keys. Generate a new key or import an existing one to use it in an identity.
keys.name: Name
keys.deleteMessage: The key “{{name}}” will be erased from the vault. The original file on disk is not touched.

import.title: Import a private key
import.intro: The key is decrypted once with its passphrase, then stored in the vault, which protects it. The original file is neither modified nor deleted.
import.passphraseHint: Leave empty if the key is not protected. The passphrase is not kept.

generate.title: Generate a key
generate.intro: The key is created inside the vault and never leaves it: only the public key is shown, copied or exported. The vault protects it, so no passphrase is needed.
generate.rsaHint: Works with older servers. Generation may take a few seconds.

deploy.title: Deploy “{{name}}”
deploy.intro: The public key is added to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the chosen host, without duplicates, with restrictive permissions (700 for ~/.ssh, 600 for the file). The connection uses the host's identity. Unix servers only.
deploy.noHosts: No hosts in the address book. Add the target host first.
deploy.passwordHint: This host has no identity. Enter its password for this deployment, or leave empty to answer the server's questions.
deploy.blocked: The host key of {{host}} has changed: deployment refused, no credentials were sent. Check the new fingerprint before deleting the old key.
deploy.present: The key was already present on {{host}}: nothing was changed.
deploy.nextStep: To log in with this key, select it in the identity used by the host (Keys > Identities).

identities.title: Identities
identities.empty: No identity. An identity groups a user name with a password and/or a key, reusable across hosts.
identities.intro: With both a key and a password, the key is tried first, then the password if the server refuses the key.
identities.name: Name
identities.passwordHint: Optional when a key is selected.
identities.passwordKeptHint: Leave empty to keep the saved password (it is never shown).
identities.deleteMessage: The identity “{{name}}” and its password will be erased from the vault.

knownHosts.title: Known host keys
knownHosts.intro: Keys accepted on first connection. If a server's key changes, the connection is blocked until the old key is deleted here.

authPrompt.title: Verification requested by the server
authPrompt.intro: The server {{host}} needs the following information to complete the connection.
authPrompt.warning: Younji will never ask for your master password here. Only enter what this server expects (remote account password, verification code…).

sftp.integrationHint: Inserts into the terminal a command (bash or zsh) that reports the current directory at each prompt (OSC 7). Review it, then press Enter. No data is added to it.
sftp.notConnected: The panel opens once the session is connected.
sftp.parentClosed: The terminal session used by this tab is closed. Reconnect it, then reopen the browser.
sftp.sectionIntro: The SFTP browser uses the connection of an open terminal session: no new authentication, same verified host key.
sftp.noSession: No connected session. Open a session from Hosts or a new tab first.
sftp.name: Name
sftp.truncated: Very large folder: only the first 10,000 entries are shown.
sftp.suspicious: Unusual name (invisible or reserved characters): it will be refused when downloading.
sftp.localHint: Choose a folder on your computer: Younji will only be able to read and write inside it.
sftp.deleteRecursive: Permanent deletion on the server, including folder contents (symbolic links are deleted, not their target): {{names}}.
sftp.conflictLocal: “{{name}}” already exists in the local destination folder.
sftp.applyToAll: Apply to the next conflicts of this transfer
sftp.summaryIgnored_one: {{count}} link or special file not copied
sftp.summaryIgnored_other: {{count}} links or special files not copied

broadcast.banner_one: Input broadcast active to {{count}} session: every keystroke is sent to it.
broadcast.banner_other: Input broadcast active to {{count}} sessions: every keystroke is sent to all of them.
broadcast.title: Broadcast input
broadcast.description: Whatever you type in one of the checked sessions will be sent to all of them. Check the list of servers before enabling.
broadcast.targets: Sessions that will receive the input
broadcast.warning_other: {{count}} sessions will receive every keystroke, including Enter and Ctrl+C.
broadcast.needTwo: Check at least two connected sessions.

snippets.intro: Reusable commands, stored in the encrypted vault. Write {{example}} for a value asked at each send.
snippets.name: Name
snippets.contentHint: One or more lines. Variables are written {{example}} (letters, digits, _ and -).
snippets.noSecrets: Do not put passwords in it: a snippet is shown in plain text in the application.
snippets.deleteMessage: The snippet “{{name}}” will be deleted from the vault.
snippets.previewPending: Fill in each variable (a single line, without control characters).
snippets.multilineWarning: Several lines: if the shell does not support bracketed paste, each line runs as soon as it is sent.

tunnels.intro: Port forwarding through a host from your address book. Each tunnel opens its own SSH connection; stopping it frees the port.
tunnels.name: Name

kindHelp.local: A port on this PC leads to a service reachable from the server (e.g. a web page that only listens locally on the VM).
kindHelp.remote: A port on the server leads to a service reachable from this PC.
kindHelp.dynamic: A SOCKS5 proxy on this PC: a browser using this proxy browses through the server.

tunnels.exposureLocal: This port will be reachable by any machine that can reach this PC (local network, public Wi-Fi…), without authentication.
tunnels.exposureRemote: This port will be reachable by any machine that can reach the server, if the server allows it (GatewayPorts), without authentication.
tunnels.exposureSocks: For a SOCKS proxy, this lets anyone pivot into the server's network on your behalf.
tunnels.exposureConfirm: I understand and expose this port to the network
tunnels.exposureEachStart: Younji will also ask for confirmation in a system window every time this tunnel starts, including automatic starts.
tunnels.autoStart: Start automatically when the vault is unlocked
tunnels.needHost: Add a host to the address book first: a tunnel always goes through a host.
tunnels.stopToEdit: Stop the tunnel to edit it
tunnels.deleteMessage: The tunnel “{{name}}” will be stopped and removed from the vault.

status.running: Active on {{listen}} — {{active}} open connection(s), {{total}} in total
